topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The city never sleeps, and neither do the wheels of corporate machinery. Got a call from an old contact, somebody's getting shuffled from one corner of the office to another. Like a card trick, only the stakes aren't just money. This city, it’s built on shifting loyalties and colder calculations. I’m not one to pry, but there's always more to the story than a simple transfer. When the shark pit decides to move its inhabitants, it’s rarely just about the shuffle. You start asking questions, poking around, and before you know it, you're ankle-deep in secrets that nobody wanted to see the light of day. The rain’s just starting, perfect for a long, uneasy night ahead. I’ll peel back the layers, see what’s really going on. But I’ll play it close to the vest. Trust is a luxury I can’t afford, not in this business.
